reason: It's right at my subway exit and they name the grade and farm, so I'd take the free sip and buy a plain matcha to see if it actually beats Matchaful. The cheesecake and cherry pie stuff isn't for me, and at $8 it has to be really good or I go back to my usual spot.
objection: Naming a farm is easy. If the plain matcha tastes like the sweet syrupy stuff on the rest of the menu, $8 is too much and Matchaful is a block away. Barely any seats doesn't matter for my commute, but it's not somewhere I'd hang out.
would_change_my_mind: If the tasting sip is bitter or flat, I'm out. If it's ceremonial-quality and properly whisked, I'd switch from Matchaful for weekday mornings.
